Subject: Scrutiny of returns filed for the tax period April 2025 to June 2025 — Discrepancies noticed — Notice under Section 61 of the Maharashtra GST Act, 2017 read with Rule 99 of the Maharashtra GST Rules, 2017.

Sir/Madam,

You have filed Form GSTR-3B for the tax periods Apr-2025, May-2025 and Jun-2025 claiming Input Tax Credit (ITC) of Rs. 18,42,000/-. However, on cross-verification with auto-populated GSTR-2B for the said period, the eligible ITC reflected therein is only Rs. 15,00,000/-.

Discrepancy noted:
   - Excess ITC claimed: Rs. 3,42,000/-
   - Period: April 2025 to June 2025 (Q1 FY 2025-26)
   - Suspected reason: Vendor non-compliance / missing invoices in 2B

You are hereby called upon to explain the discrepancy within 30 (thirty) days from the date of receipt of this notice, failing which proceedings under Section 73/74 of the CGST Act, 2017 will be initiated for recovery of the said tax along with applicable interest under Section 50 and penalty as per law.

If you wish to make any submission, please reply through Form GST ASMT-11 on the GST common portal within the stipulated time. Supporting documents may be uploaded as Annexures.

In case you require any clarification, you may visit this office during working hours.

Failing which, demand-cum-show-cause notice in Form DRC-01 shall be issued under Section 73(1) of the CGST Act, 2017.

(signed)
Assistant Commissioner of State Tax
Ward 04, Mumbai
